profile.headline: Software Engineer in Test at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary: Experienced QA Automation Engineer with 6 years in testing web-based software applications in Agile environments. Skilled in automation tools like Selenium, Cucumber, JUnit, TestNG, Rest Assured, and JDBC. Proficient in Java, CI/CD with Jenkins, and GitHub. Expertise in MySQL and Oracle relational database testing, and REST API testing using Postman and Rest Assured. Strong communication, organizational, and multitasking skills.
